title: Uplumo: SEO and AI search analytics with honest pricing
excerpt: Track Google rankings, audit your site and see where AI assistants mention you and send visitors. Start free; paid plans from $15 a month.
content_html:
AI traffic tracking on every plan

See what AI says about your brand.

Find brand mentions and cited pages in sampled AI answers. Understand your Google rankings, prioritise website fixes and measure recognised AI referrals—all in one workspace.

No card for Free · paid tools depend on your plan · cancel from Billing

What you get

See the evidence. Choose your next improvement.

01 · AI Visibility

Know when AI names you, and when it names your rival.

Inspect brand mentions and cited sources, compare selected prompts across supported AI models, and track saved questions over time. Brand Lookup coverage differs from live prompt checks; available engines and markets are shown in the tool.

02 · AI traffic

See the AI referrals you can measure.

Our cookie-free tracker recognises supported AI referrers and campaign tags. See their landing pages and visits. When no identifying signal is available, the source remains unknown or Direct.

03 · Site audit

Find technical issues worth fixing first.

Crawl your site and get the issues that matter most first, each explained in plain language with a suggested fix.

04 · Rankings

Track the keywords that bring customers.

Track your keywords in Google and find new ones worth targeting, with search volume and difficulty explained.

05 · For agencies

Reports with your logo, not ours.

Record completed work, observed outcomes and next steps. Share a client review link when ready. White-label reports with your own name, logo and colours are available on Business.

A practical workflow

From “why am I not visible?” to a page you can improve.

Work with your own website and evidence. Choose paid checks when you need them; review the credit information before starting.

01 · Investigate

Ask the questions your customers ask.

Use AI Visibility to inspect sampled answers and their sources. Track selected questions by engine and market, and keep brand mentions separate from actual citations.

02 · Diagnose

Use Site Audit to prioritise page improvements.

Crawl your site and review technical, content and AI readiness issues page by page. The checks explain what Uplumo found; they do not predict whether an AI will cite you.

03 · Improve

Keep your judgement in the writing process.

Edit your own content, add images and use search briefs or focused AI suggestions. Review facts and proposed changes before applying or publishing to a connected WordPress site.

04 · Measure

Check what changed, then report the work.

Follow rankings, saved AI answers and website traffic. Connect your Google data where available. Record actions and observed outcomes in a client report; a change after an edit is evidence to investigate, not proof of causation.

Feature access, engine coverage and usage depend on your plan and configuration. Optional AI actions and JavaScript rendering are separate credit-using actions.

Built for your work

One business website, or a portfolio of clients.

For business owners

Start with your website's traffic and technical issues. Add research and tracking when you know the questions you want answered. You do not need to use every tool to get started.

For SEO specialists and writers

Move from keyword and competitor evidence to a search brief and an editable draft. Use content scores as review prompts, and keep your experience, facts and original examples in the final article.

For agencies

Keep client sites in separate projects, invite teammates within your plan limits, and explain work with evidence and next steps. Choose Business when your reports need your own branding.

Built with 3 years of SEO and AEO experience, backed by full-stack AI engineering experience. Read how we approach search measurement.

Questions

Asked before signing up.

What is Uplumo?

An SEO and AI search platform. It tracks your Google rankings, audits your site, shows where AI assistants mention your brand and measures the visitors they send you.

How is it different from other SEO platforms?

Uplumo combines site analytics, Google search data, SEO research and AI visibility. Choose a tier by the number of websites and tools you need.

What is AI traffic detection?

Uplumo Analytics recognises supported AI referrers and campaign tags, then shows their visits and landing pages. Without an identifying referrer or tag, a visit stays unknown or Direct. It cannot recover every untagged AI visit or connect an individual visit to a particular AI answer.

Does AI Visibility cover every answer?

No. Brand Lookup uses provider datasets with engine and market limits. Prompt Explorer compares selected prompts across supported models; API answers may differ from consumer apps. Saved tracking measures your chosen questions, not every private AI conversation.

Will Uplumo guarantee rankings or sales?

No. Uplumo provides research, measurement and suggested improvements. Search engines and AI platforms decide what appears; content scores and observed traffic do not guarantee customers or revenue.

Does the tracker need a cookie banner?

The tracker sets no cookies and stores no IP addresses. Default visitor-day counts use a daily-changing hash. Optional new/returning recognition uses first-party browser storage; enable it only after obtaining any required consent and updating your privacy notice.

Do I need technical skills?

No. Every finding is explained in plain language, with what to do next. Adding analytics means pasting one script tag into your site.

Know where you stand. Make your next move.

Start with the free plan. Explore your website before choosing paid research or AI tools. No card needed.

Start free, no card →

问题

Asked before signing up.

What is Uplumo?

An SEO and AI search platform. It tracks your Google rankings, audits your site, shows where AI assistants mention your brand and measures the visitors they send you.

How is it different from other SEO platforms?

Uplumo combines site analytics, Google search data, SEO research and AI visibility. Choose a tier by the number of websites and tools you need.

What is AI traffic detection?

Uplumo Analytics recognises supported AI referrers and campaign tags, then shows their visits and landing pages. Without an identifying referrer or tag, a visit stays unknown or Direct. It cannot recover every untagged AI visit or connect an individual visit to a particular AI answer.

Does AI Visibility cover every answer?

No. Brand Lookup uses provider datasets with engine and market limits. Prompt Explorer compares selected prompts across supported models; API answers may differ from consumer apps. Saved tracking measures your chosen questions, not every private AI conversation.

Will Uplumo guarantee rankings or sales?

No. Uplumo provides research, measurement and suggested improvements. Search engines and AI platforms decide what appears; content scores and observed traffic do not guarantee customers or revenue.

Does the tracker need a cookie banner?

The tracker sets no cookies and stores no IP addresses. Default visitor-day counts use a daily-changing hash. Optional new/returning recognition uses first-party browser storage; enable it only after obtaining any required consent and updating your privacy notice.

Do I need technical skills?

No. Every finding is explained in plain language, with what to do next. Adding analytics means pasting one script tag into your site.
